name: karabo-device-development
description: Guidance for implementing, reviewing, debugging, and testing Karabo devices and synchronous macros across the C++, bound-Python, and middlelayer APIs, including behavior-driven pytest and coverage analysis. Includes draft Boost Cobalt guidance for new and converted Karabo C++ coroutine workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test Karabo devices and synchronous macros.
interface.longDescription: Routes Karabo device and macro work to detailed guidance for classic C++, bound-Python, asynchronous middlelayer devices, and synchronous macros. Includes workflows for targeted pytest tests, regression tests accompanying implementation, failure diagnosis, fixtures, and behavior-driven coverage improvement. Bundles a draft C++ coroutine skill with branch-derived AMQP, TCP and WebSocket material and explicit open design decisions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Implement, review, or test this Karabo device or synchronous macro using the correct API and pytest guidance.
